entities.name: otel-demo/Deployment/checkout
entities.reasoning: Deployment checkout failed to match desired replica count and its pods stayed non‑ready, triggering replica‑mismatch and pod‑not‑ready alerts.
entities.evidence: KubeDeploymentReplicasMismatch and KubePodNotReady alerts firing at 17:55; scaling events show replica changes but pods never become Ready.

entities.name: otel-demo/Pod/checkout-d75b77f99-hgc68
entities.reasoning: Pod remained in non‑ready state, causing the service to have no healthy endpoints.
entities.evidence: KubePodNotReady alert for this pod; events show repeated ScalingReplicaSet without Ready transitions.

entities.name: otel-demo/Service/checkout
entities.reasoning: Service had zero requests because its backing pod was not ready, leading to NoRequestsDetected alerts.
entities.evidence: NoRequestsDetected alert for checkout at 17:57; downstream services also show zero traffic.

entities.name: otel-demo/Service/frontend-proxy
entities.reasoning: Frontend‑proxy received errors when calling checkout, raising its RequestErrorRate warning.
entities.evidence: RequestErrorRate warning for frontend‑proxy at 17:41 and 17:54; correlation with checkout outage.

entities.name: otel-demo/Service/frontend
entities.reasoning: Frontend observed high error rate due to upstream checkout failures.
entities.evidence: RequestErrorRate warning for frontend at 17:56 with error rate 3.04.

entities.name: otel-demo/Service/recommendation
entities.reasoning: Recommendation service showed error rate spikes likely caused by downstream checkout timeout.

entities.evidence: RequestErrorRate warning at 17:40 and NoRequestsDetected at 17:58.
